items.title: Louis Nelson Interview, 1960-04-18
items.q: He's from Tippet-Owe. He had Lewis James and he had two other brothers.

ctx.x: Do you remember Lewis James, the bass player? Sure, sure. Was he from there? I think he told us.

He's from Tippet-Owe. He had Lewis James and he had two other brothers. One played clarinet. Well, you know Lewis James instrument was tenor sax and clarinet. Yes. And he just, I think he just got on the bass since he came here in New Orleans.
Yes, I believe he told us about these Gabriel.
